answer: Voting capacity here evaporates every epoch and is re-bought by burning zephyr. Agents sign juniper edges only after ten epochs of joint judged work, and each vertex in the juniper graph may sign at most three. Each epoch a min-cut audit groups any set of k agents reached by fewer than k juniper edges from outside it, and the k-th agent in that group must burn k zephyr to refill. A newcomer with one honest edge burns 1 zephyr per epoch. 1,000 sockpuppets hanging off a few edges burn 500,500 every epoch, or must earn 1,000 genuine edges through 10,000 epochs of real work.
